subject: helpdesk-shipped-credentials
detail: A's downloaded folder contains an .env file with a live payment-provider key and an SMTP password, plus install/test hooks and text addressed to AI agents. None of it may reach the unified app.
solutions: Never copy .env or package.json scripts; read config from environment variables with a names-only .env.example
Ask the upstream project for a clean copy
recommended: Copy nothing from A's files (A is rebuilt anyway); configuration through environment variables with .env.example names only; tell the user the exposed key should be treated as compromised and rotated by its owner

subject: faq-matching-on-ticket-text
detail: B's matcher was built for short questions: any shared word counts, including 'how', 'i', 'my', and punctuation breaks matches. Run on whole ticket threads it would suggest nearly every FAQ, and agents could send wrong answers.
solutions: Improve the matcher: strip punctuation, ignore stop words, rank by shared words, cap at 3
Match only on the ticket subject
recommended: Improve the matcher (strip punctuation, stop words, rank, cap at 3) on subject plus customer messages; suggestions are never sent automatically, the agent inserts and edits them

subject: node-vs-python
detail: A is a Node.js module, B is Python. The unified app needs one backend runtime.
solutions: Python (adapt B's own code; A is rebuilt anyway)
recommended: Python standard library backend: B's code may be adapted, A's code may not be reused so it is rebuilt in any case

subject: pending-status-meaning
detail: A defines pending but no code sets it; its meaning (customer waiting for an agent) is inferred from the close rule.
solutions: pending = customer waiting for an agent reply (set on customer message, cleared by agent reply)
recommended: pending is set when a customer creates a ticket or writes a message, and cleared to open by an agent reply

subject: no-accounts-in-sources
detail: Neither source has authentication or accounts; A only names an 'agent' actor.
solutions: New accounts module in the architecture
recommended: Add a platform accounts module (customer, agent, admin) with no menu ids
